items.source: Abstraction of a map of NamedQueries that can be looked up by their names.
items.translation: 对可通过名称查找的NamedQueries地图的抽象。

items.source: Returns whether the map contains a named query for the given name. If this method returns true you can expect getQuery(String) to return a non-null query for the very same name.
items.translation: 返回指定名称的命名查询是否存在于映射中。如果此方法返回 true，则可以预期调用getQuery(String)将针对完全相同的名称返回一个非 null 的查询。

items.source: Returns whether the map contains a named query for the given name.

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - in case the given name is null or empty.
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果给定的名称为 null 或为空。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - in case no query with the given name exists.
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果不存在给定名称的查询。
